jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
People Operations Specialist

If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place.

Backed by General Catalyst, the investors behind companies like Stripe and Airbnb, we're building something extraordinary.


Our Mission 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale.

We do this in two ways:

  • Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes.

  • Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive.

And we're already making a difference:

  • $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022.

  • Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database.

  • 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week.

  • Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb, alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam.


What We're Building Next 🚀

We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide.

By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently.

Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems.

That's where you come in 🫵

Join us as People Operations Specialist and help us build a People function that’s simple, dependable, and able to scale!

💜 We are considering applications for both permanent and contract employment 💜


We're looking for someone to join us in building the next chapter of our People function at Goodstack.

Over the past four years, we've grown more than 8x, from 22 to around 200 Goodstackers across multiple countries. It's been an incredible journey, and with that kind of growth comes a whole lot of interesting challenges.

We've built a strong foundation, but there's plenty of opportunity to make the experience of working at Goodstack even better.

We're looking for someone who enjoys People Operations, gets satisfaction from making complicated things simple, and cares just as much about the little details as the bigger picture. Someone who understands good HR practices, takes ownership, asks thoughtful questions and doesn't wait to be told what needs doing.

In this role, you'll have plenty of autonomy, the opportunity to shape how we work, and a close partnership with the Head of People as we continue scaling the function.


✍️ A note from the Head of People:

Hey, future Goodstacker! 👋

I don't expect you to know everything (who does?), but I do expect you to know your HR foundations, bring good judgement, take ownership and stay curious.

And if you're the kind of person who gets a little too excited about a beautifully organised process, I have a feeling we'll get along brilliantly!


As People Operations Specialist, your mission will be:

Making the Goodstacker experience brilliant

  • Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle, from onboarding and employment changes to offboarding, ensuring every experience is smooth, organised and thoughtful.

  • Prepare and quality-check employment contracts, amendments and other documentation, ensuring accuracy and alignment with applicable employment requirements.

  • Keep our People systems, employee records and documentation accurate, organised and up to date.

  • Be the go-to person for day-to-day People questions, providing sound HR guidance, resolving routine matters independently and escalating more complex issues.

  • Partner with Talent, Finance, IT, managers and external providers to ensure smooth coordination across teams.

Keeping global People operations running smoothly

  • Coordinate payroll inputs, deadlines, employee benefits and employment changes across our locations.

  • Manage the operational administration of our international Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements.

  • Support right-to-work checks, immigration and sponsorship administration.

  • Apply HR policies and employment best practices consistently, identifying compliance risks and escalating them early.

  • Keep on top of statutory deadlines and employment obligations, working with external specialists when needed.

Making things better as we grow

  • Coordinate the operational delivery of performance reviews, progression and compensation cycles.

  • Maintain People reporting, policies, templates and internal documentation.

  • Use your HR knowledge to identify gaps in our processes and recommend practical improvements.

  • Find opportunities to simplify workflows and use AI and automation to eliminate repetitive work.


What success looks like:

  • Every new Goodstacker has what they need before Day 1 and feels welcomed from the start.

  • Contracts, payroll inputs, employee changes and records are accurate and delivered on time.

  • Our people and managers can count on you for reliable advice, clear answers and helpful support.

  • You apply sound HR judgement, spot risks early and resolve routine matters without constant oversight.

  • Our People processes run smoothly, with fewer manual steps and less time spent chasing admin.

  • You proactively identify opportunities to strengthen compliance, consistency and the employee experience.

  • Ultimately, you're creating the operational reliability that allows us to spend more time improving the experience of working at Goodstack.


This role is a perfect match for you if you have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on People / HR Ops experience, ideally in a growing, international business.

  • A formal qualification in Human Resources Management, People-related degree, CIPD, or an equivalent recognised professional qualification.

  • A solid understanding of UK employment legislation and HR best practices, with the confidence to apply your knowledge to everyday People matters.

  • Experience preparing employment documentation, managing employee lifecycle processes and supporting payroll and benefits administration.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling contracts, payroll, employee data and anything where accuracy really matters.

  • Strong organisational skills and follow-through, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

  • Experience with UK HR administration, alongside exposure to international employment or EOR arrangements.

  • Confidence working with People systems, spreadsheets and payroll processes, with a strong understanding of confidentiality and data handling.

  • Sound judgement and ownership, knowing how to solve problems independently and when to ask for support.

  • Clear, kind communication and a genuine interest in helping people.

  • An AI-native mindset, using AI, automation and technology thoughtfully to simplify work, improve accuracy and increase efficiency.


Bonus if you have:

  • Worked in a fast-growing startup and enjoy building things as you go.

  • Experience automating People Ops workflows.

  • A soft spot for a good cup of tea or smoothie 🫖.

🇬🇧 What you can expect upon joining our team

💰 Salary reviews and share options becoming an integral part of our growth and share in the company's success

💝 Goodstack’s Workplace Giving

⚕️ Vitality Plus - Private health insurance

🌞 £250 Brighten your day annual budget

🤓 £1000 Learning & development annual budget

📚 Goodstack library

🌯 Tasty Tuesday! Office lunch is on the company

🏃🏿‍♀️ Slow run club Wednesday

⭐️ Paid days off to volunteer for non-profit causes

🎤 Paid days to attend conferences

🥳 Paid day off on your birthday!

🌴 25 days annual leave, plus paid public holidays

💙 Paid sick leave

🧘🏽 Paid wellness leave

🪁 Parental leave

🧸 Workplace nursery scheme

🧓🏽 Pension (with tax-efficient salary sacrifice option)

🚴🏾 UK cycle-to-work scheme

🌳 Ecologi carbon offsetting

⚖️ Flexible working hours

🖥️ WFH budget upon joining

🏡 You're always welcome to pop in more often if you enjoy the buzz of being in the office. It's a warm, friendly space right in the heart of London

🙌 … and so much more


About us

Since 2017, Goodstack has been at the forefront of creating a future where good will be built into everything we do. From daily commutes to weekend activities or grocery shopping, we envision a world where creating positive change is seamlessly integrated into our everyday lives. In this future, the depth and breadth of impact we can make through everyday actions will expand dramatically – benefiting both businesses and the world.

Businesses are expected to deliver on both profit and purpose and those that don’t are falling behind. We’re here to make it easy for any company, anywhere in the world, to integrate good into what they do. Doing this empowers everyone – companies, employees, consumers, and communities – to contribute to positive change and take meaningful action.

Let's do this! 💜

OUR PLEDGE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

We take pride in our diverse and growing team representing 20+ nationalities across 5 continents 🌍! Our continued expansion provides us with opportunities to embrace and celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, essential to our success. We actively seek and welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

A team that represents the world that we are trying to support is a wiser, more knowledgeable and stronger one. We’re excited for you to bring your experience, yourself and your special lemon twist to Goodstack to propel us forward in striving to create a better world for us all.

Check out our Careers Page for more details!

Freelance Question Reviewers

About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. Thatâs why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyoneâregardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identityâis valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

jobs.description:
Software Engineer AI Tooling

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What Youâll Be Responsible For

  • Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

  • Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

  • Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

  • Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

  • Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

  • Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

  • Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

  • Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

  • Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

  • Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

  • Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must have:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

  • Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

  • Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

  • Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

  • Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

  • Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

  • Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

  • Know Postgres and relational database practice.

  • Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

  • Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

  • Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

  • Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

  • Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

  • Experience across several product surfaces or teams.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. Itâs a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If itâs in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to supportânot replaceâexisting tools and communities.

jobs.title: Italian Multimedia Content Reviewer
jobs.description:
Italian Multimedia Content Reviewer

About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

Job Description Summary

In this exciting position, the Multimedia Content Reviewer will be responsible for writing, adapting, reviewing, and evaluating a wide range of linguistic and multimedia content in Italian, ensuring the highest standards of linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and overall quality for customers using the world's foremost multimedia platforms.

The role combines creative and editorial expertise with analytical and quality evaluation skills, covering traditional localization work as well as emerging content types, including AI-generated content, linguistic annotation, and structured content evaluations.

With time, the Multimedia Content Reviewer will become the cultural ambassador for their language market and will be expected to produce fully localized content, flag potential cultural issues, and articulate suggestions to make all content appropriate and relevant for the target market.

The ideal candidate possesses a background in journalism, editorial content, copywriting, or a related field, has proven creative writing skills, and a keen attention to detail. They should also demonstrate strong critical thinking, sound editorial judgment, and the flexibility to navigate different workflows, guidelines, and content evaluation methodologies.

In addition, we're seeking candidates who are passionate about music, film, sports, gaming, and technology, and have a knack for iOS and macOS devices.

Main Duties

  • Localize, translate, and adapt content of various categories (i.e. multimedia, legal, technical, marketing, sports, entertainment, health and wellness, and other digital content) while adhering to writing style guides and project-specific guidelines.

  • Write new copy for a range of multimedia products such as music, TV, film, sports, apps, video on-demand, game subscription services, and more.

  • Copy-edit and fact-check content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and cultural relevance.

  • Perform LQA (Localization QA) testing of content published on live platforms (music and app descriptions, marketing material, and marketing campaigns).

  • Evaluate human-written and AI-generated content for linguistic accuracy, fluency, relevance, consistency, and adherence to project-specific quality standards.

  • Perform linguistic annotation, content classification, and structured evaluation tasks using predefined guidelines, rating scales, and quality criteria.

  • Identify and document errors, inconsistencies, and quality issues, providing clear, actionable feedback and supporting rationale for evaluation decisions.

  • Conduct market-specific research on local content treatment, audience preferences, cultural nuances, product and terminology trends, and best localization practices for the target audience.

  • Report on data and/or assets across a broad scope of media and content types, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with project requirements.

  • Collaborate with global language teams via virtual meetings and email on content review tasks to align on terminology, style, quality standards, evaluation criteria, and market-specific insights.

Requirements

  • BS/BA and 2+ years of work experience in journalism, copywriting, editing, digital media, content production, or a related field.

  • Experience in translation and localization of multimedia content or demonstrated experience adapting content for Brazilian audiences.

  • Native-level proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese, with excellent grammar, writing, editing, and linguistic judgment skills.

  • Ability to quickly detect issues and inconsistencies across large volumes of content and make sound judgment calls based on the information at hand.

  • Ability to interpret and consistently apply detailed guidelines, rating scales, and evaluation frameworks across different projects.

  • Familiarity with AI-generated content, linguistic annotation, content evaluation, or data quality assessment is a plus.

  • Is in tune with and has a wide range of knowledge of music, film, TV, sports, gaming, technology, and Brazilian pop culture.

  • Has the ability to own linguistic quality for the Brazilian Portuguese market and make confident linguistic decisions.

  • Must be highly detail-oriented with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines.

  • Fluency in written and verbal English.

  • Strong computer literacy; knowledge of iOS/macOS systems is a plus.

  • Ability to work independently and remotely.

  • Collaborative; enjoys teamwork in a multicultural environment and is open to feedback, calibration, and continuous learning.

Compensation

Additional Information

Part-Time Greece, Romania, Spain

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first point of contact for Level 1 tickets and ad-hoc helpdesk requests covering hardware, software, and workplace services across Statista's global workforce.

  • Take ownership of incoming requests from qualification through resolution or escalation, ensuring timely updates, complete English documentation, and SLA compliance.

  • Identify recurring issues and report patterns to the Workplace Manager to drive continuous improvement of IT services.

  • Experience with identity and access management solutions (e.g., Microsoft 365 administration, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta - Statista uses Okta) and endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune

  • Experience working with ITSM ticketing systems (Statista uses ServiceNow) and IT asset management tools (Statista uses Snipe-IT)

  • Hands-on, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivering great user experiences

Global Partnerships BD Lead

About the Role
We are looking for a Global Partnerships BD Lead to develop and manage strategic partnerships across priority global markets. Working closely with the Global Marketing team and local teams, you will negotiate commercially sound terms, protect brand budgets, and enable local teams to work with high-quality marketing, financial media, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) resources for brand marketing. Your work will help build viable and sustainable partnerships that strengthen the company's global brand presence.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop a global partnership resource pool across financial media, financial portals, KOLs, Web3, CFD, Fintech, sports/IP, lifestyle, YouTube channels, newsletters and community leaders. Proactively identify and engage high-quality global and regional partners to expand brand reach in priority markets.
- Build and maintain a global resource map covering each partnerâs vertical market, audience quality, commercial rates, historical performance, potential risks and long-term partnership value, so teams can make faster, better-informed selection decisions.
- Negotiate pricing, contract terms and renewals with partners and suppliers, representing the company in securing stronger benefits, better rates and sustainable long-term arrangements, including annual framework agreements and long-term partnership discounts.

Protect brand budgets from inflated pricing, low-quality traffic and inefficient allocation, and review payment milestones, cancellation terms, make-good mechanisms and contractual liabilities.

Maintain resource pricing databases across markets to improve ROI.

Document successful partnership cases to replicate best practices, optimise or replace underperforming partnerships where appropriate, and apply strong brand awareness and compliance sensitivity across the regulatory requirements of CFD, online trading and financial services markets.

What Weâre Looking For

- Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work with senior stakeholders, local teams and external partners across cultures. Strong written and spoken English is required.
- Good awareness of brand safety, advertising and compliance considerations in regulated financial services.
- Bonus: experience in CFD, trading, fintech or digital assets; established relationships across financial media, KOLs, events or sports/IP; Chinese proficiency for communicating with Chinese-speaking stakeholders and partners.

What We Offer
- Global exposure and the opportunity to shape partnership strategy across multiple markets, with learning and career development opportunities within a leading global trading platform.
- Competitive compensation and benefits package.
- A collaborative, international team environment where your commercial judgement directly influences how the companyâs brand investment is spent.

Location & Eligibility Note: This role is 100% Remote. While this listing uses "Paris" system tag as a location, we are actively hiring marketing talent based anywhere within European time zonesâincluding the UK, EU, and non-EU European countries.

We are seeking an experienced Financial Lead in processes and control to help modernise and scale a global finance function operating across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction environment.

Reporting to the VP Finance, you will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of Finance through process redesign, technology enablement, data governance and operational excellence.

This role sits at the intersection of finance operations, systems, data and business performance. You will be responsible for transforming core finance processes, improving controls, implementing enabling technologies and ensuring that transformation initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable business value.

Unlike a traditional programme management role, success will not be measured solely by project delivery. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, validate outcomes and ensure that process and system changes translate into tangible improvements in close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness and decision-making.

You will play a key role in consolidating information from a diverse systems landscape, improving data quality and governance, and helping establish a single source of truth for financial and operational reporting.

About Inbolt

Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes.

Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch, and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents.

We're a team based in Paris, Detroit, and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role:

This position is Paris, France based.

Role Overview

Your mission is to own the integration of complex robotics features into Inbolt Studio, at 100% industrial-grade quality, from architecture to production on the factory floor.

As Senior Robotics Engineer, you are the technical reference for robot control and robot programming in our product. Our roadmap covers static and dynamic robot control whatever the brand. You will architect and build these capabilities, integrate them end to end into Inbolt Studio, and make sure they run reliably on real robots in demanding production environments.

You will work at the intersection of robotics, 3D perception, and software engineering, in a small fast growing team where your contribution is visible and your decisions shape the product. This is not an R&D position: your work has a daily impact on what runs in production at Inbolt customers.

Want to take your robotics career to the next level by building the future of robot vision guidance in the real world? This role is for you.

Responsibilities

Feature ownership and architecture

  • Push the limits of the current codebase and propose better architectures when needed

Industrial-grade quality

  • Guarantee industrial-grade quality: every feature is tested, validated on real robots, robust to edge cases, and safe to run in a factory

  • Set the standards for code quality, testing, and review in the robotics team, and keep the PR process efficient

  • Own the quality of your deliverables: code, engineering reports, and validation results

  • Estimate lead times fairly for Epics, deliver on schedule, and flag early when a plan is drifting

From lab idea to production

  • Turn prototypes into production features, validated in real factory conditions at customer sites

  • Integrate and validate Inbolt’s solution across industrial robot brands and their programming environments

  • Keep a solid view of the state of the art in robotics, and bring what is relevant into the product

Technical leadership and collaboration

  • Act as the technical reference for the application engineering (RAE) and sales teams on complex customer cases, feasibility, and escalations

  • Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and take part in interviews for new hires

Profile

Inbolt values end-to-end ownership, high rigor, and a hands-on curiosity. We move fast while staying precise, with a proactive, autonomous, results-driven mindset and strong collaboration with engineering teams.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of strong professional experience in robotics, in a startup or a large company, with a track record of owning complex features end to end

  • Strong expertise in robotics motion planning: trajectory generation, path planning, collision avoidance, and motion optimization for industrial robot arms

  • Strong expertise in real-time robot control, both static and dynamic (sensor-driven): closed-loop control, low-latency sensor-to-motion pipelines, and deterministic, performance-critical code running on real robots

  • Excellence in software development: strong Python and/or C++, solid engineering practices (testing, code review, version control, CI/CD)

  • Proven record of shipping complex robotics features to production at industrial-grade quality: reliability, test strategy, and validation on real robots

  • Ability to design abstractions that work across robot brands and programming languages

  • Solid foundations in robotics: kinematics, frames and transformations, and integration with industrial or collaborative robot arms

  • Technical leadership: you make architecture decisions, raise the bar in code reviews, and mentor other engineers

  • Appetite for fast development and visible impact: you iterate quickly, ship often, and take ownership of the result

  • Clear communicator, able to explain technical topics to engineers, sales, and customers

  • Fluent in English; French is a big plus given daily interactions with the Paris team

Additional Plus

  • A PhD in robotics or a related field is appreciated, as long as your focus is on shipping: this role is about production impact, not research

  • Experience with 3D vision, point clouds, computer vision, or machine learning applied to perception

  • Experience with industrial robot brands (Universal Robots, ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau) and their programming languages

  • Experience as a tech lead or team lead of a robotics team

Position details

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (Europe)
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive (Europe)

About Valdera:

At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide.

We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.

Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you.

Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together.

About the Role:

We are looking for a seasoned Enterprise Account Executive to lead our expansion in the European market. In this role, you will be responsible for navigating complex, multi-threaded sales cycles with some of the largest chemical and manufacturing enterprises in the region.

You will act as a strategic partner to procurement leaders and supply chain executives, helping them modernize their sourcing operations through Valdera’s cutting-edge technology. This is a high-impact role for a consultative seller who understands the intricacies of industrial supply chains and can navigate large organizations to close significant deals.

Role Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close for large enterprise accounts across Europe, with a specific focus on the industrial hubs within the DACH region.
  • Navigate complex organizations by building consensus across multiple stakeholders, including CPO (Chief Procurement Officers), R&D heads, Supply Chain leads, and IT/Digital Transformation directors.
  • Go beyond transactional sales; diagnose deep-seated supply chain inefficiencies and present Valdera as a strategic solution for resilience, cost savings, and speed-to-market.
  • Act as the "boots on the ground" for our European expansion, providing feedback to Product and Leadership teams on regional market nuances, regulatory requirements (e.g., REACH), and customer needs.
  • Rigorously manage your pipeline and forecast with accuracy, ensuring a consistent flow of new business opportunities.
  • Proactively iterate on and improve Valdera’s sales playbook and process, including lead generation, discovery, follow-up messaging, negotiations, and closing strategies.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Professional Experience: 5–10 years of total working experience.
  • Sales Expertise: A minimum of 5 years of closing experience in enterprise sales (Global 2000), specifically managing multi-threaded deals with average contract values (ACV) that require executive-level sign-off.
  • English: Native or professional fluency is required.
  • German: Business fluency is highly preferred to effectively manage relationships with key stakeholders in the DACH region.
  • Highly Desirable: Experience selling into the Chemicals, Manufacturing, or Supply Chain/Procurement sectors. You understand the language of BOMs, RFQs, and raw material sourcing.
  • Acceptable: A strong background in Management Consulting (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG) focused on operations/supply chain, combined with proven sales experience.
  • Enterprise DNA: You have experience navigating the bureaucracy of large enterprises and have the patience and grit to drive deals to completion.
  • Location: Remote within Europe. Living in the DACH region is preferred.

Characteristics that Win

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You genuinely want to understand how things are made and the chemistry behind the products we use every day.
  • High Agency: You don’t wait for a playbook; you see a problem, and you solve it. You are comfortable working with ambiguity in a high-growth startup environment.
  • Consultative Mindset: You don't just sell software; you sell a transformation in how companies operate.
  • Builder Mentality: You love building a business and shaping processes; you don’t wait for it to show up.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Valdera?

Ownership: Founding member of our European GTM team with significant autonomy. Opportunity to grow into Sales Management.

Impact: We are not just optimizing clicks; we are fixing the physical supply chain that the world relies on.

Growth: Work alongside a world-class team from top tech and industrial backgrounds in an environment that prioritizes rapid career acceleration.a

Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the role's requirements. We will make a compelling offer for the right candidate.

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. Full-time employees are eligible for premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance coverage. You will be provided with a more detailed breakdown of your options before joining Valdera.

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. jobs.title: Technical Director
jobs.description:
Technical Director

This is a permanent full-time remote opportunity for those based in Ireland.

About Nearform
Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

As part of our Delivery Management function, you will help our clients build solutions and platforms, launch new product ventures, and fundamentally change how they operate.

You will work as part of a highly skilled, multidisciplinary team, typically consisting of designers, developers, DevOps engineers, and members of the client team.

Whether you’re a Delivery Manager, Technical Lead, or Technical Director, you will act as the bridge between client needs and timelines, ensuring the delivery of innovative, scalable solutions.

About the Technical Director role

As a Technical Director at Nearform, you will provide strategic and technical leadership across multiple projects, ensuring alignment with business goals while fostering innovation and excellence. Your role will involve technical vision-setting, client engagement, and team leadership to drive both project success and long-term growth.

  • Technical Strategy & Leadership – Define and communicate a clear technical vision, ensuring best practices in architecture, software development, and emerging technologies. Act as the final authority in critical design and delivery decisions.
  • Client Engagement & Advisory – Serve as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, and senior stakeholders. Lead discovery workshops, translate business objectives into technical strategies, and develop tailored solution proposals.
  • Project Execution & Delivery – Oversee technical execution, ensuring quality, scalability, and maintainability. Monitor project health, identify risks, and ensure successful outcomes through proactive leadership.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development – Work with resourcing teams to ensure the right talent is staffed on projects. Foster a culture of excellence, mentorship, and innovation across teams.
  • Financial & Operational Oversight – Manage project burn-down, optimize resource allocation, and identify revenue growth opportunities while maintaining financial accountability.
  • Industry Influence & Thought Leadership – Stay ahead of industry trends, contribute to open-source projects, and engage in public speaking, blog writing, and mentorship. Champion Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and sustainability initiatives within Nearform.

What we are looking for in this person

  • 15+ years of technical leadership experience, ideally within consulting, SaaS, or large-scale digital transformation projects.
  • Deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, and modern development practices.
  • A strong track record of guiding technical decisions on complex, high-impact projects.
  • Experience leading pre-sales, discovery, and solution design discussions.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • A consultative mindset, able to align business needs with technical strategies.
  • Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills to influence at all levels.
  • Hands-on experience with AI, databases, distributed systems, and modern software engineering best practices.
  • Experience leading and mentoring senior software development teams
  • A passion for continuous learning, innovation, and professional excellence.

Preferred Skills

  • Previous experience working in a fully remote, globally distributed environment.
  • Background in financial oversight of technology projects.
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects or technical thought leadership.
  • Prior exposure to AI-driven solutions and emerging technologies.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 24 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - We understand the importance of continuously learning so we offer an allowance of up to €1000 you can use to upskill yourself.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Call (30 mins, Zoom)
    An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (1 hour, Zoom)
    A conversation with the Head of Delivery or CTO focused on your approach to delivery management, client collaboration, and technical problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.
  • Panel Interview (1.5 hours, Zoom)
    A discussion with 2 Technical Directors focusing on your team leadership and delivery management approach in more detail. This includes scenario-based questions on team management, delivering technical work, and client collaboration, assessing how you drive success in an enterprise development environment.
  • Final Interview (45 mins, Zoom)
    A final chat with the Managing Director for the region to discuss the plans for this role, Nearform’s strategy, and any questions you may have.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees.

Full-Time Ireland

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Designer  (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d)

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer

  • You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet.

  • You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones.

  • You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production.

  • You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on.

  • You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against.

    You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary.

  • You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships.

You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it.

How we design:

  • We're AI-native. We use AI tools daily in our own process, not just in what we design, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default. This is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and verification moments that make that real, not just a confidence score bolted on.

  • We ship in production, not just in Figma. Craft is judged by what clinicians actually use, so we stay close to what ships.

What to expect as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.


Here's how we picture you as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • You have 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years operating at Senior, Principal, or Staff altitude.

  • You have designed for AI and non-determinism before, and can talk concretely about how you've communicated agent behaviour, handled errors, and kept users in control, not just in the abstract.

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as of January 2027, as Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 

What Will Your Role Be

As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) in our Merchant Experience team, you’ll help build and evolve the digital products our partners and merchants interact with every day. You’ll work across the entire merchant journey — from the Partner Area, where designers manage their designs and shops, to the sign-up and publishing experience that turns an idea into a live SpreadShop, and the Merchant Area, where SpreadConnect merchants manage integrations with Shopify, TikTok, and other platforms. As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d), you’ll take ownership beyond individual UI components or API endpoints. You’ll design and implement features end-to-end, collaborate closely with product and design, and ensure that the experiences you build are reliable, performant, and easy to evolve. Your work directly impacts how merchants use and grow with our platform. You’ll build products that make their day-to-day work easier and help drive our business forward.

What You´ll Do 

  • Build and evolve merchant-facing product surfaces — sign-up and shop creation flows, shop management, design and product administration, sales statistics

  • Build the new publishing journey for shops — from sign-up to a live SpreadShop — and take drop-off out of every step

  • Own small to medium features end to end: design the UI, build theKotlin/Spring endpoints behind it, model the data, and ship both together

  • Extend our backend services where your features need it — new REST endpointsin the shop and partner services, data model changes with a proper migration, and integrations with external platforms such as Shopify or TikTok on the SpreadConnect side

  • Design and consume our REST and GraphQL APIs, and push back when a responseshape makes the frontend's life harder than it needs to be

  • Contribute to our cross-team frontend architecture work — shared components,hooks and API clients, and how we render, test and ship our apps

  • Keep merchant tooling fast — data-heavy tables, sales statistics and editorsare where perceived performance is won or lost

  • Take on larger topics — an epic, a new integration, a new merchant surface —and break them down into something the team can execute: slices, dependencies, open questions, and a first piece worth shipping

  • Work in an agile cross-functional team with a product owner, designers and backend engineers, and connect what you build to merchant activation and conversion

What You´ll Bring

  • Solid proficiency in TypeScript and React — component design, hooks, statemanagement, and the performance patterns that keep a growing app fast

  • Around three or more years of professional experience building web products, with a track record of features you carried from first ticket to production

  • Real CSS craft and experience working inside a design system or shared component library, not just against one

  • Experience consuming REST or GraphQL APIs and working with structured, data-heavy responses — product catalogs, variants and attributes bring more complexity than they first appear to

  • Working experience in a JVM backend — Kotlin or Java with Spring — and the ability to build a REST endpoint, model the data behind it and write the migration, not just read the code

  • A solid grasp of relational databases and SQL, and of what happens to a query when the table stops being small

  • Self-direction: you take an under-specified problem, find out what is actually needed, break it into deliverable pieces and drive them to donewithout waiting to be handed tickets

  • Testing as a habit rather than an afterthought, and a working relationship with code review

  • A keen eye for UI detail — you care about how something feels, not only whether it works

  • A product mindset: you ask who benefits from a change before you ask how to build it

  • Good communication skills in English

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description:
Security Architect

Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

jobs.title: Project Sceptrum - Multilingual AI Coding Evaluation Specialist - Dutch
jobs.description:
Project Sceptrum - Multilingual AI Coding Evaluation Specialist - Dutch

Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November

  • Languages: Dutch

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

  • Project compensation: varies depends on different programming language

  • Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

  1. Language test: short exercises in the target language.

  1. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

  1. Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

  1. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

Job Reference: #L1-CC1

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Welo Data?

✨ Limitless Flexibility 

Project-based opportunities that fit your availability. Choose when and how much you want to contribute—fully remote, with complete autonomy. 

🌱 Limitless Growth 

Optional access to AI and Large Language Model workshops designed specifically for professionals like you. No coding required—just your expertise. 

🌍 Limitless Support 

Be part of a global contributor community with responsive guidance and support. 

💡 Real Impact 

Apply your expertise in the Legal field to influence the AI systems shaping the future of your industry—while collaborating with data professionals and expanding your skills.

How to Apply?

Apply now by answering a few quick questions to join our database and become part of our growing community.

About Welo Data

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.
